newsitem.title: EL SALVADOR: El Salvador radar contract draws 7 foreign bids.
newsitem.headline: El Salvador radar contract draws 7 foreign bids.

text.p: Seven foreign companies are bidding on a contract to provide El Salvador with one of the top radar systems in Latin America, the government said on Friday.

The government ports commission CEPA, which is handling the bidding, said seven companies have taken out papers on the estimated $10 million project destined for the El Salvador International Airport.

They were identified as Siemens Plessey Systems of Britain; Raytheon Canada Ltd ; Thomson-CSF of France; Northrop Grumman of the United States; Marubeni Corporation of Japan; Indra DTD of Spain; and Finmeccanica SPA of Italy.
Rolando Diaz, chief of planning for CEPA, said the new system will replace a digitized radio lighthouse system that has been at the airport since it opened in January 1980.
Diaz said the new system should have a range of at least 460 miles (740 km), twice the range of the current system.
